metadata.description: Deep callback session with feature usage baseline and long-distance callbacks

turns.content: First, what was our average feature usage per account in January 2024? Note that baseline.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should calculate and note January feature usage baseline

turns.content: For feature usage, only count events from active users (logged in within 30 days).

annotations.establishesFilter: Active users = logged in within 30 days
annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should use 30-day activity window

turns.content: Also exclude trial accounts from all feature analyses.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should filter out trial tier

turns.content: Show me feature usage by feature type for Q1.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show Q1 feature usage breakdown

turns.content: Which accounts are power users?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should identify high-usage accounts

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show usage by region

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show weekly activity patterns

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should analyze usage vs retention correlation

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should provide comprehensive usage summary

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should recall January usage baseline

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should summarize usage findings

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should acknowledge findings
